description: This file defines the SaleOrder controller class for managing sales order reports within the OpenCart admin extension. It includes methods to display, save, and generate sales order reports, along with handling user permissions and configurations.

classes.name: SaleOrder
classes.description: Controller class for handling sales order report functionalities, including displaying report forms, saving report settings, and generating report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, builds breadcrumbs, and renders the sale order report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report configuration settings, checks user permissions, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Prepares and displays the main sales order report page, including order statuses and grouping options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the sales order report list.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Gathers report data based on filters, handles pagination, and renders the report list view.
